answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 25948 Country: India Title: How the property will be divided between one wife two sons n two daughters? Question: how the property will be divided between one wife two sons n two daughters Answer ID: 25948 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2097/H=626/th=1431) After due rights preceding inheritance, all the property of the deceased person (movables and immovables) shall be divided into 48 shares. The widow of deceased shall get 6 shares, each son 14-14 shares and each daughter 7-7 shares. Detail: Wife: 6 Son: 2x14= 28 Daughter: 2x7= 14 Total: 48 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
